_doc: Repos that get the shared git hooks (pre-push = the `git sync` engine, pre-commit = secret guard, post-merge/post-checkout = submodule sync). Data-driven: cloud-git-hooks-install.sh iterates this list, points each repo's core.hooksPath at the shared dir, and declares the `sync` alias. Add a repo here — no script edit. `root` is relative to $HOME unless it starts with /.
